wiHróh₁ is instrumental; 'the word of a raging man' needs gen. wiHrósyo agreeing with gʰrémontos
subject ménesh₂ is neuter plural 'minds'; 'the mind chooses' needs nom. sg. ménos. Also wélh₁t gnomic aorist where present wolh₁éyeti exists (minor)
h₁uséwih₂ fem. of u-stem adj. (cf. Gk -eia) acceptable
